summary: Thara rebrand + welcome-email + light/dark toggle verified end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 tests PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py (added 3 new tests: welcome-email on customer register, welcome-email + vendor-record on vendor register, GET /api/ reports 'Thara API'). Found + FIXED a real backend bug: register endpoint called send_email(..., text=text) but the helper signature is send_email(..., preview=''); the TypeError was being swallowed by try/except so registration returned 200 but the welcome mock was NEVER emitted. After fixing to `preview=preview` in server.py:293, [EMAIL mock] with subject 'Welcome to Thara, <name>!' is logged for both customer and vendor registration. Login-alert subject now correctly reads 'New sign-in to your Thara account' (previously EventPro). Booking (2 emails + 2 pushes), status transitions, review, and payment/verify (mock) receipt notifications all still fire. Frontend: on mobile viewport 375x667 the strings 'EventPro' / 'EVENTPRO' do NOT appear on /, /login, /home, /profile, /points, or /settings — only the demo credential hint 'customer.demo@eventpro.in / Demo@123' remains on /login (allowed, it's an email address). /settings renders with all three testIDs (theme-system / theme-light / theme-dark). Tapping 'theme-light' updates the active checkmark on the row and switches the preview card background from midnight to warm cream (visible in screenshots). After page reload the choice persists — localStorage['thara:theme-mode'] === 'light' (AsyncStorage backing key confirmed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:293 — welcome-email call previously passed `text=` kwarg to send_email() which only accepts `preview=`. The TypeError was swallowed by the try/except, silently disabling the welcome mock. Fixed in this iteration (kwarg renamed). Consider tightening the try/except to only catch httpx/network errors so future signature mismatches surface immediately.

notifications.py — module-level _push_client is created at import time capturing the initial X-Push-Key header; consider constructing it lazily so a later env change is picked up without a full restart.

server.py root emits {service: 'Thara API'} but referral share_text still contains 'https://eventpro.in' (line ~676). Not on the customer-facing UI checklist so left as-is, but worth updating for full rebrand consistency.

/app/backend/tests/test_notifications.py (added 3 tests: customer-register welcome mock, vendor-register welcome+vendor-record, /api/ returns 'Thara API')

context_for_next_testing_agent: Welcome-email dispatch bug was fixed in this iteration (kwarg mismatch). If the register endpoint is refactored, ensure send_email uses preview=..., not text=.... All notification-log assertions read /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log via byte-offset seek. Backend was restarted mid-iteration; supervisor is clean. Referral share_text still contains 'eventpro.in' link (not user-facing so out of scope for this pass). Frontend backend URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL — the test file also honors that env var name.
rca_of_issue: Register→welcome-email was silently failing because server.py called `send_email(to=..., subject=..., html=..., text=text)` while notifications.send_email() has signature `(to, subject, html, preview='')`. Python raised TypeError('unexpected keyword argument text') which the surrounding try/except caught and logged as a WARNING. Registration itself returned 200 (bug was silent), but the '[EMAIL mock]' log line never appeared. Fix: rename kwarg to `preview=preview`. Verified by re-running the pytest suite — welcome-mock line now present for both customer + vendor register.
